Light-Up LOVE Letters for Hire in Sydney

LOVE sign hire for weddings, engagements and anniversaries: four large light-up letters and a free light-up heart, delivered, set up and collected across Sydney.

The letters

Four letters, 3.5 metres of glow

L, O, V and E, each 1.2 metres tall and about 3.5 metres end to end: a big, illuminated LOVE sign that guests can stand beside. These LED love letters have white bulbs set into a powder-coated white frame and run from one power point.

We hold two of every letter, so the set stays available when another booking uses an L or an E on the same day. Light up love letters and love light up letters are the same four pieces; you can price LOVE in the builder to see them at scale. Some people search for them as LOVE marquee lights.

Special

LOVE plus a free light-up heart

Every LOVE hire includes a 1.2m light-up heart at no charge. Place it after the E for a five-piece row.

Four letters qualify for the 5% multi-piece discount, so the hire is $376 for the event day with the heart included. Weekend and full-week rates are on our package prices page.

Occasions

Weddings, engagements, Valentine's and vow renewals

Weddings

At the end of the aisle for the ceremony, then behind the bridal table for the reception. We can move the letters between the two on the day. A love sign for wedding hire sits alongside our other wedding letter lights.

Engagements

LOVE for the party, MARRY ME for the proposal first, and or spell MR & MRS on the wedding day itself.

Valentine's and vow renewals

A restaurant terrace on Valentine's Day, an anniversary dinner at home or a vow renewal in the garden. Add the year in numbers for an anniversary.

Placement

Where LOVE photographs best

Aisle end

Behind the celebrant and slightly off-centre, so the letters frame the couple without blocking the view. Allow 4 metres of width.

Behind the bridal table

Allow 3.5 metres of clear wall and keep about 40 cm between the chairs and the letters. We tape the lead along the skirting.

Dance-floor edge

Against a dark wall the white bulbs stand out in phone videos, and the letters stay in frame for the first dance.

How it runs

How a LOVE hire runs: booking, set-up and collection

Book with a week's notice

Send the date and the suburb or venue and reserve your date. We confirm the same business day. A 30% deposit, paid by card through a secure Stripe link, holds the letters; the balance and a $200 refundable bond are due seven days before.

Set-up before guests

We arrive one to three hours ahead, or inside your venue's bump-in window, place the letters and the heart, tape the lead and switch on.

Collection

The same night or the following morning, at a time agreed when you book. Switch the lights off when the event ends and leave the letters where we placed them.

Weather and damage

If the weather turns or a letter is damaged

LOVE is not waterproof. When rain is forecast the letters go under cover or indoors; if no dry spot exists on the day, we move the hire to a new date or refund the hire fee, keeping the delivery fee once the crew has left for your venue.

Everyday wear costs you nothing. If a letter comes back with a broken bulb panel or a dented frame, the reasonable repair or replacement cost is deducted from the $200 bond, with photos, and the rest is refunded within one to two business days. A cancellation more than 14 days out returns the deposit less a $50 administration fee.

FAQ

LOVE letter hire FAQs

How much is it to hire LOVE letters?

$376 for the four 1.2m letters for your event day. Four pieces attract the 5% multi-piece discount, and a light-up heart is included free. Delivery, set-up and collection is added by zone, from $240 in Western Sydney.

How wide are the LOVE letters?

About 3.5 metres in one row at 1.2 metres tall. In a narrower space the letters can be split, two either side of an aisle.

Is the heart included?

Yes. Every LOVE hire includes a 1.2m light-up heart at no extra charge, so you get five pieces for the price of four. It usually sits after the E.

Can LOVE go outside at a garden wedding?

Yes, on a flat, dry surface. The letters are not waterproof, so if rain is forecast they go under a roof, pergola or marquee. The bases are weighted for lawns and terraces, and we bring levelling blocks.

How long can we keep the letters?

Standard hire is your event day: we set up before the ceremony or reception and collect the same night or the next morning. A weekend hire (Friday to Monday) is 1.5 times the price and a full week is 2.2 times.

Do you set them up?

Yes. We deliver the letters, place them where you want them, tape the lead and switch them on, and we return to collect them. You do not need to move anything.

How much notice do you need for LOVE?

At least one week. That gives us time to confirm the four letters and the heart for your date and to agree a set-up window with you or your venue.

Are the LOVE letters electrically tested?

Yes. Each letter is electrically tested and tagged before every hire. The bulbs are white LEDs, and outdoors we run them from an RCD-protected board with outdoor-rated leads.

Do you deliver LOVE to my suburb?

We deliver across Greater Sydney from Lidcombe. The fee is by zone: $240 for Western Sydney, $240 South West, $240 the Hills, $260 Inner West and CBD, $140 Shire and St George, $300 Eastern Suburbs and $320 North Shore and Northern Beaches.

How are the LOVE letters powered?

From one standard power point within 5 metres of the display. We bring the leads. The four letters and the heart together draw less than a kettle, so a normal household or venue socket is enough.
